notes: The twenty-five pages of amendment register at the back of this document are skipped. Every insertion they record already appears in the consolidated body - 'INDOOR PARKING FACILITIES' is defined on page 10 and recorded again on page 179 - so parsing them duplicated provisions and, because register entries carry no section number, filed them under whichever section came last. Two clauses of 14,030 and 13,304 characters were built that way.
The definition question therefore asserts the term is found under section 2, where the body defines it, and not under the 11.28.2 the register was inheriting.
Definitions are unnumbered, so they cite the section that introduces them rather than a position in the list.

questions.question: What is an indoor parking facility?
questions.why: This term is defined once in the body and recorded again in the amendment register. Retrieving the register copy means citing a historical record as if it were the provision.

questions.question: What uses are permitted in a residential zone?
questions.why: A zone's permitted-use list, which is what a resident is usually asking for.

questions.question: Does a utility use have to be fenced?
questions.why: A three-part section number, which is this bylaw's own convention.
